body:
## Summary

`dag.CurrentModule().Source()` and `dag.CurrentModule().GeneratedContextDirectory()` no longer **re-resolve the running module's declared dependencies**. The already-loaded dependency DAG (`Module.Deps`) is reused for codegen, so these APIs now work in modules whose dependencies point at **private git repositories**, even when the runtime caller doesn't hold the module author's credentials.

Fixes the issue reported on Discord: a module using `dag.CurrentModule().Source().Directory("src")` failed with git auth errors when the module had private HTTP-authenticated git dependencies — forcing the author to pass the directory through `New` as a workaround.

## Root cause

Call chain before this change:

```
CurrentModule().Source()
  → generatedContextDirectory (dagql select)
    → runGeneratedContext → runCodegen → runSDKCodegen
      → loadDependencyModules(...)          ← re-resolves declared deps from config
```

`loadDependencyModules` resolves the module's dependencies from its `dagger.json` — network access, and for private git deps, credentials. At runtime this runs under the module's nested client: the implicit-credential path in `core/schema/git.go` deliberately withholds host credentials from module code, and the trusted `WithModuleDependencyResolution` fallback only reaches the *session's originating client's* credential helper. If the runtime caller isn't the author (CI, module consumers), dependency re-resolution fails — even though the module is **already fully loaded and executing**.

The re-resolution is redundant by construction: `moduleSourceAsModule` builds `mod.Deps = loadDependencyModules(...)` at load time — the exact `SchemaBuilder` codegen needs.

## The fix

- Thread an optional `preloadedDeps *core.SchemaBuilder` through `runGeneratedContext` → `runCodegen` → `runSDKCodegen`; when non-nil, `loadDependencyModules` is skipped.
- Extract `generatedContextDiff` from `moduleSourceGeneratedContextDirectory` so it can be called with preloaded deps.
- `currentModuleSource` and `currentModuleGeneratedContextDirectory` now compute the generated context via a shared `currentModuleGeneratedDiff` helper that passes the running module's `Deps`.
- All other paths (`dagger develop` / `generate` / workspace migrate / changesets) pass `nil` and behave exactly as before.

Besides fixing the auth failure, this removes a redundant dependency-loading pass from every `CurrentModule().Source()` call (faster, no network dependency).

## Not covered (follow-ups)

- **Client generators** (`modCfg.Clients` → `runClientGenerator`) still resolve their generator modules by ref; a module with a *private generator module* would hit the same class of problem. Same technique applies if it comes up.
- No new integration test yet: staging "author had credentials at install, runtime caller doesn't" needs a private-repo fixture with credential scoping across two clients. Existing suites (`TestCurrentModuleAPI`, module config/codegen tests) cover the refactored paths for regressions. Happy to add the fixture if reviewers want it in this PR.

## Testing

- `go build` / `go vet` / `gofmt` clean; `core` unit tests pass.
- Local dev-engine integration validation was blocked by a host-environment Docker networking failure (containers currently have no outbound connectivity on my machine — unrelated to this change). Opening as **draft for CI to run the integration suites**.
title: fix(core): stop re-resolving deps in CurrentModule source APIs
